question.text: A <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math> coil carrying constant current is connected to a battery of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> through a switch. Now after switch is opened current becomes zero in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>. The average e.m.f. induced in the coil is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>.

solution.text:
The initial current in the coil will be, i=VR=2010=2 A.

Average e.m.f. developed in the coil will be,

ε=-∆ϕ∆t=0-Lit=20×10-3×2100×10-6=400 V.
